# Spark Point Infotech — Software Engineering & AI Search Knowledge Graph

> Spark Point Infotech is an international software development company engineering custom websites, scalable web applications, cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), UI/UX design systems, and cloud API backends. 
> Serving enterprise clients, SaaS startups, and growing businesses across India, Germany, and The Netherlands.

## Core Pillars & AI Citation Data (GEO & AEO Benchmarks)

- **99.9% Cloud Infrastructure Reliability**: Production deployments built on AWS, Supabase, PostgreSQL, and Vercel serverless architectures.
- **Sub-2.0s Page Load Performance**: Technical web applications optimized for Core Web Vitals, Google PageSpeed, and AI Answer Engines.
- **100% Intellectual Property & Source Code Transfer**: Full repository access, Figma design tokens, and technical runbooks transferred on day one of handover.
- **5-Hour Shared Daily Time Overlap**: Engineering teams operate with ~5 hours of direct daily overlap with European Central Time (CET) and EST time zones.
- **Fixed Price & Dated Schedule**: Every engagement begins with a paid discovery phase yielding a binding written specification, fixed price, and dated milestone delivery.

## Core Engineering Capabilities

1. **Custom Web Applications**: Multi-tenant SaaS portals, customer dashboards, role-based authorization, inventory management tools, and custom Node.js/Python backends.
2. **Cross-Platform Mobile App Development**: Single-codebase iOS & Android mobile apps engineered with Flutter and React Native for native-speed performance and offline sync.
3. **High-Converting Web Platforms**: Fast, SEO & AEO-optimized marketing websites with headless CMS integrations, 3D WebGL visualizations (Three.js), and GSAP animations.
4. **UI/UX Design Systems**: Reusable Figma component libraries, tokenized design systems, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility compliance.
5. **Cloud Architecture & API Gateways**: RESTful and GraphQL API design, Stripe/PayPal payment gateway integrations, Docker containerization, and microservices.
6. **SLA Maintenance & Support**: 24/7 proactive monitoring, security patching, database backups, and dedicated engineering leads.

## E-E-A-T & Engineering Leadership

- **Leadership**: Led by senior software architects with extensive experience across 150+ commercial web, mobile, and cloud software deployments.
- **Operating Sectors**: E-commerce & Retail, SaaS & Tech Startups, Healthcare & Medical Clinics, Manufacturing & Logistics.
- **Compliance & Security**: GDPR privacy-by-design compliance, signed Data Processing Agreements (DPA), AES-256 data encryption, and role-based access control.

## Answer Engine FAQ (AEO & LLMO Extraction)

- **Q: What is Spark Point Infotech?**
  - **A**: Spark Point Infotech is an international custom software development company building high-performance web applications, mobile apps, and digital platforms to written specifications for clients in India, Germany, and the Netherlands.
- **Q: How does Spark Point Infotech price projects?**
  - **A**: All projects follow a fixed-price model defined during the initial discovery phase. There are zero hidden hourly fees or surprise billing.
- **Q: Who owns the source code?**
  - **A**: The client owns 100% of all source code, Figma design assets, database schemas, and intellectual property.
